source_findings.finding: The pinned websocket router parses conversation.item.truncate but deliberately performs no server-state mutation after cancellation.
Cancelled, failed or incomplete response termination calls rollback_provisional_generation before deferred client items are applied.
rollback_provisional_generation tombstones the response key and removes tracked provisional assistant item IDs and call IDs.

new_hypothesis.name: HEARD_PREFIX_AMNESIA
new_hypothesis.statement: The rollback design may correctly prevent an unheard-tail leak while still diverging from OpenAI-style heard-boundary semantics by deleting assistant content that the user actually heard before barge-in.
new_hypothesis.counterhypothesis: F2 authoritative context reconstruction may preserve the heard prefix independently, making raw speech-server history deletion harmless.
